name: New Berlin (United States)
description: Horizontal tricolour of purple, white and purple, the white bearing the name NEW BERLIN in red, with a white disc bearing a blue map of Wisconsin in the upper hoist and a white disc with line drawings of buildings in the lower hoist.
history: New Berlin is a city in Waukesha County, Wisconsin. Flags of the World records this design as the previous flag and notes that by 2016 the city was flying a white flag with its municipal logo.

features.role: disc with a blue map of Wisconsin
disc with line drawings of a rooftop, church and tower
